name: copy-as-menu
title: Copy as menu
description: Copy the same thing in the format the next tool wants: a split button whose menu offers Markdown, JSON, cURL or plain text and remembers the last choice.
docs: Each format's serialize() runs only when someone copies in that format, and may return a promise. Pass format and onFormatChange to keep the last choice yourself (in local storage, say), or defaultFormat to leave it to the button. Picking a format in the menu copies in it at once. Set as on a format when it reads badly after Copy as: "plain text" for Plain text. Formats carry functions, so build them in a client component.
